answer: Each identity locks 70 credits and joins via a sponsor staking 100 credits in the bridge fund, both in the basalt book. Each epoch the sponsor renews; each idle epoch adds one umber mark, and three marks slash the stake and burn the bond. One sponsor backs at most three identities, so rented reputation collapses as marks mount. Renewal 15 first, then 15+4(k-1), 1,000th 4,011; 1,000 fakes pay 2,013,000 plus 70,000 bonds. Honest agents pay 15 once.
